subfamily: layered (Pousse Café): no Codex root; nearest the Old-Fashioned (spirit and sugar, no citrus), built in the glass, no ice
glass: small stemmed pousse-café or cordial glass (about 75 ml), narrow and flared
version: v1 (Tomás, round 2, 2026-10-04). Story: the Pousse Café (Oxford POUSSE CAFÉ pdf 1557-1558; Wren r1 accepted the plan's lead with conditions). Three layers by weight, heaviest first: white crème de cacao (clear), tawny port, bourbon steeped with raw beetroot (the darkest, on top). Spark: Flavor Matrix COCOA pdf 84, beet is a surprise pairing for cocoa (and pdf 87 puts beet with chocolate); port is the wine both beet (pdf 48, best: wine) and cocoa (pdf 84, best: red wine) like. Freeform: no dilution, no ice; numbers are for the whole glass, per-layer values are the rows themselves.
